maddeler.e:
نتفاهم (form VI)
# نَتَفَاهَمُ (natafāhamu) /na.ta.faː.ha.mu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَفَاهَمَ (tafāhama)
# نَتَفَاهَمَ (natafāhama) /na.ta.faː.ha.ma/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَفَاهَمَ (tafāhama)
# نَتَفَاهَمْ (natafāham) /na.ta.faː.ham/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَفَاهَمَ (tafāhama)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
